probe.description: AD Defense v1 - Sensitive file probes
probe.expression: (ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.git") or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.git/" or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.svn") or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.svn/" or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.hg") or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.hg/" or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.ssh") or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.ssh/" or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.aws") or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.aws/" or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.kube") or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.kube/" or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.env") or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.env." or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.env/" or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.env~") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.netrc") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.s3cfg") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/id_rsa") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/id_ed25519") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-config.php.bak") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-config.php.old") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-config.php.save") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-config.php.swp") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-config.php~"))

guard.description: AD Defense v1 - Preserve submissions and WP sessions
guard.expression: (not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} or http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_" or http.cookie contains "wordpress_sec_" or http.cookie contains "wp-postpass_" or lower(http.cookie) contains "regnum" or http.cookie contains "wp_woocommerce_session_" or http.cookie contains "woocommerce_items_in_cart" or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "preview=" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "preview_id=" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "customize_changeset_uuid=" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "rest_route=" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "gf_" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "gform_" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "wc-ajax=" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "add-to-cart=" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "cornerstone=" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "cs_preview=")

rate.description: AD Defense v1 - Public pages 30 per 10s per IP
rate.expression: not cf.client.bot and not (lower(http.request.uri.path) in {"/wp-login.php" "/wp-cron.php" "/xmlrpc.php" "/wp-comments-post.php" "/wp-signup.php" "/wp-activate.php" "/robots.txt" "/api"} or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-admin") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-json") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/cdn-cgi/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.well-known/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/api/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/graphql") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/webhook") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wc-api") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/cart") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/checkout") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/my-account") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".css") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".js") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".mjs") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".map") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".jpg") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".jpeg") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".png") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".gif") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".webp") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".avif") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".svg") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".ico") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".woff") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".woff2") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".ttf") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".otf") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".eot") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".mp4") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".webm") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".mp3") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".wav") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".ogg") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".m4a") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".m3u8") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".ts") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".vtt") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".srt") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".pdf") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".zip") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".xml") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".txt") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".json"))
